meta_description:
133 likes, 4 comments - amitbhawani on September 1, 2026: "Are B by Lenskart actually SMART glasses? 👓

After using them in the real world, my favourite feature isn’t Gemini. It’s actually the camera, especially the ability to shoot hands-free landscape video.

For POV shots and B-roll, they’re genuinely useful.

But there are some big Gen-1 problems:
• Gemini feels very limited
• Battery drains surprisingly fast
• Meeting transcription wasn’t reliable for me
• Couldn’t find the original meeting audio to verify it
• Software still needs polishing
• Build feels slightly delicate for heavy outdoor use

My biggest feature request? Dashcam Mode.

Keep a rolling 3-minute video buffer while driving, but don’t save anything permanently. If something happens, simply say “Save the last 3 minutes.” Otherwise, keep overwriting it. That would be an amazing use of camera glasses.

My current verdict?

Camera glasses + audio = YES.
Truly “smart-smart” glasses = Not yet.

But the potential is definitely there.

Would you use something like this every day?".
